fields.description: The opaque docname series. A member is never keyed by an email or a membership number. Mutable data does not go in a primary key.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Who this person is, read from their Red Profile every time this page opens and stored nowhere on this record.
fields.label: Identity Card

fields.description: What this person is to the society right now, worked out from the memberships below when the page opened.
fields.label: Standing

fields.description: Every membership this person holds, at every branch you are entitled to see, with how each one was paid for.
fields.label: Memberships Held

fields.description: Who approved or verified this person's memberships, and when. Read from the approval decisions on each record.
fields.label: Verification History

fields.description: The person, as onerc_core's identity spine. This is the only identity this record holds: no name, email or phone is stored here, because a second copy of a person is a second answer to who they are. Read those through Red Profile.
fields.label: Red Profile

fields.description: What this person is to the society, and the truth of it: the affiliation row on Red Profile is a summary written from here, never the other way round. Written by the membership services, not by hand.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When this person first became an active member. Set once, at the first activation, and never moved by a later renewal.
fields.label: Joined On

fields.description: Anything the membership office needs to record about this person's membership that is not a field.
fields.label: Notes
